C01 and C12 share congressional advocacy and European assistance themes, but their language and organization are less closely aligned with the child's investment-and-integration argument.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"the uniting of Europe is a necessity for the peace and prosperity of Europeans and of the world","parent_excerpt":"a strong and self-supporting economic system in the free world...in the cause of peace and prosperity","explanation":"Both frame European or free-world economic integration as a means to peace and prosperity."},{"child_excerpt":"The new Community does not wish to obtain grants for these purposes, but requires loan capital.","parent_excerpt":"stimulating in every practical way the flow of private investment abroad...Both we and our friends abroad earnestly desire to see regular trade and investment replace grant assistance.","explanation":"This is a distinctive shared financing premise: investment should replace grant aid."},{"child_excerpt":"a portion of the financing of this development program by the United States Government or one of its agencies...would foster European integration","parent_excerpt":"Through increasing two-way international trade and stimulating in every practical way the flow of private investment abroad we can strengthen the free world","explanation":"The child adapts C25's general investment-based mechanism into a specific proposal for financing the Community."},{"child_excerpt":"Your Committee might consider this an appropriate occasion to express its approval","parent_excerpt":"I now recommend that a commission be established to make this review.
